summary: Configured node1 to synchronize through pool.ntp.org using Chrony. Synchronization is active, enabled at boot, and recovered successfully after a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Backed up the original Chrony configuration.
Configured `pool pool.ntp.org iburst` while retaining `makestep` and `rtcsync`.
Restarted Chrony and verified live synchronization.
Restarted node1 once and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified Chrony remained enabled and returned to synchronized state after restart.

evidence.requirement: Synchronize the system clock with pool.ntp.org
evidence.summary: Configuration shows pool.ntp.org; Chrony selected a live source with NTP synchronized=yes and leap status Normal.

The restart was acknowledged, boot ID changed from 9ed9e820-6949-4971-a6a0-9fda0c2ea7ee to 6dbd8422-f576-4a86-9ec4-00076c133750, and post-restart evidence shows Chrony active, enabled, configured for pool.ntp.org, and synchronized.
Captures the healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and fully recovered time-service state.
